package.name: gnss_driver
package.description: ROS 2 driver for the u-blox ZED-F9P (ArduSimple simpleRTK2B). Reads the receiver's NMEA stream over a swappable transport (default: USB CDC-ACM serial via pyserial) and publishes sensor_msgs/NavSatFix (with RTK status and covariance) plus an optional geometry_msgs/TwistWithCovarianceStamped velocity.
